VAR-age.why: Personal register has numeric age (Age on Dec 31, 2023)

VAR-agecat.why: Age categories can be derived from continuous age

VAR-childmth.why: Child age in months (<5) can be derived from age in years

VAR-childyr.why: Child age in years (<5) can be derived from age

VAR-school.why: Current education activity Yes/No indicates current enrollment

VAR-educat7.why: Highest education level attained (diploma/certificate) with multiple ordered categories

VAR-educat5.why: 5-category education level can be derived by collapsing detailed highest education level attained

VAR-educat4.why: 4-category education level can be derived by collapsing detailed highest education level attained

VAR-primarycomp.why: Primary completion can be derived from highest education level attained

VAR-educy.why: Years of education may be approximated/derived from highest education level attained if no direct years-schooled item exists

VAR-everattend.why: Ever attended school can be derived from highest education level attained (and possibly FE010 for current attendance)
